author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I am vibe coding the whole service to only use a single instance of Postgres.  Why bother with all other databases and microservices if Postgres can be the one database that rules them all. 

Front end, back end, database schema, all in one giant mono repo.  Let's see how far it can go before everything starts falling apart.
